title: Galician-Style Grilled Octopus
description: A traditional Spanish dish from the region of Galicia, this recipe features tender and flavorful grilled octopus. The warm, earthy flavors of the paprika and garlic complement the rich taste of the seafood.

ingredients.name: Octopus (pulpo)
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Smoked Paprika (pimentón)
ingredients.notes: Smoked to give a warm, earthy flavor

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality oil for a rich flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher or sea salt for a more complex flavor

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground for a more vibrant flavor

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed for a bright, citrusy flavor

ingredients.name: Fresh Parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped to add a fresh, herbaceous flavor

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the paprika mixture to the octopus and toss to coat.
4. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
5. Grill the octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
6. Transfer the octopus to a plate and squeeze lemon juice over the top.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
8. Serve with a side of crusty bread or a salad for a complete meal.
